name: Going Up
hint: "0/4" on a lift: it rises with four aboard, and sinks if anyone steps off. Jump off together!
why4: The lift only rises with all four aboard, so a crate (not a friend) has to hold the plate that opens the gate at the top.
solution: P3 and P4 move right out of the way. P1 stands against the shelf at x=5; P2 jumps off P1's head onto the shelf (height 3), grabs the crate at x=1, walks off with it and drops it (Down+Grab) on the plate at x=12-13: gate A at the top (x=30) opens.
Everyone hops the crate (walking into it would push it off the plate) and the 2-wide pit at x=17-18; P4 touches the key at x=21.
All four stand on the lift at x=26-29 (4/4); it rises 10 tiles to the workbench top.
At the top all four jump right through gate A at the same time: as soon as one steps off, the lift (now short of four) slides back down with whoever is still on it.
P4 opens the door at x=40; all press Down.
Recovery: anyone left at the bottom needs the whole team: the others drop back down the shaft and ride up again with them.
